text:
maria.support: Customer (Alice) opened: streaming completions work in Node but fail in Vercel Edge. Says getReader throws. Pasted minimal edge route and package.json.

maria.support: package.json snippet: "@redwood/inference-sdk": "0.12.2" and Next/Vercel using edge functions.

maria.support: repro (edge route):
```ts
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference-sdk';
export default async (req) => {
  const c = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
  const s = await c.streamCompletion({ model: 'gpt-open-3', prompt: 'ping' });
  const r = s.getReader(); // throws: getReader is not a function
  // ...
};
```

customer-alice: Error from Vercel Edge at runtime:
`TypeError: s.getReader is not a function`

kevin.engineering: likely the SDK returned a Node-style Readable instead of a Web ReadableStream after bundling. In true edge (web) env getReader should exist.

kevin.engineering: can you confirm which Vercel runtime and build target? edge functions vs serverless? and Do you use webpack/rollup/swc target?

maria.support: Alice: "Edge Functions (vercel-edge), Next.js app, didn't set any extra build flags."

danielle.devex: v0.12.x had branching behavior: sometimes it returns Node streams depending on bundler transforms. We introduced consistent web-stream returns in v0.13.0+. Recommend upgrade to 0.13.1 if possible.

danielle.devex: quick workaround you can try in the edge route without upgrading: normalize to a Web ReadableStream by doing `new Response(maybe).body` which converts Node stream -> Web stream in edge. Example:
```ts
const maybe = await c.streamCompletion(...);
const web = (maybe && typeof maybe.getReader === 'function') ? maybe : new Response(maybe).body;
const reader = web.getReader();
```

sre-jen: also check client retry config. Old SDK auto-retries on certain failures which can cause duplicate SSE chunks or truncated streams if a retry is attempted mid-stream. Ask customer to set `retry: 0` to rule that out for repro.

kevin.engineering: ask them to log `typeof s` and `s.constructor && s.constructor.name` before calling getReader. That helps us see bundler polyfill.

maria.support: Alice posted back logs:
`typeof s = object`
`s.constructor.name = Readable`

maria.support: She also reported odd SSE behavior when using EventSource: connection closes with "unexpected end of input" and sometimes duplicated payload chunks after reconnect.

danielle.devex: duplication + truncation = classic retry + no dedupe header. In 0.13.x we added `x-rw-stream-id` on stream responses and client-side session id handling to drop duplicate ranges. 0.12.x lacks that.

kevin.engineering: action items for support: 1) try Response(...) workaround in their edge route 2) set `retry: 0` 3) collect minimal reproducible repo or bundle (server bundle + package-lock/yarn.lock + vercel.json) 4) upgrade path note: 0.13.1 includes web stream normalization and retry/dedupe fixes.

maria.support: Sent those steps to Alice and asked for a small repro or permission to copy a minimal example. Also suggested testing locally with `vercel dev --edge` to mirror the production bundler.

customer-alice: Trying workaround now, will report back. Thanks.

kevin.engineering: when they share a repo I'll run it in `vercel dev --edge` and also bundle with SWC/next to see if the SDK import gets transformed. If we can reproduce we'll add a targeted fix that forces web-stream return in edge-like globals.

sre-jen: note for release docs: migration note that older 0.12.x may yield Node streams in edge; recommend either Response(...) fallback or upgrade. Also mention SSE idempotency header addition.

support-bot: ticket RW-CA-4287 created and linked.

maria.support: closing this slack thread pending repro upload from customer. Will reopen once we have a repo. :white_check_mark:
